subject.title: fix(memory): scale heap pressure thresholds to V8 limit

question: Should gateway defaults automatically scale heap-pressure warning and critical limits to V8’s heap limit using these 25–50% and 50–75% bands, including the earlier recovery behavior on constrained heaps?
rationale: The patch fixes the reported false positive but also changes the restart-driving default policy for existing deployments without a documented current contract selecting these exact proportional bands.

options.title: Approve proportional defaults after proof
options.body: Confirm the proposed bands as the gateway policy after a real large-heap run demonstrates the false-positive critical event no longer occurs.

options.title: Preserve fixed defaults with opt-in behavior
options.body: Keep current defaults and require an explicit supported setting or migration path for proportional threshold behavior.

options.title: Choose different proportional bands
options.body: Retain adaptive sizing but set warning and critical percentages based on the desired restart headroom for constrained and enlarged heaps.

recommendation.title: Approve proportional defaults after proof
recommendation.body: Confirm the proposed bands as the gateway policy after a real large-heap run demonstrates the false-positive critical event no longer occurs.
